option_relations.rationale: Chemotherapy-induced arrhythmia is a complication of chemotherapy-induced cardiotoxicity.
Chemotherapy-induced sinus arrhythmia is a specific type of arrhythmia that can be a complication of chemotherapy-induced cardiotoxicity.
Early-stage Chemotherapy-Induced Cardiac Dysfunction is essentially equivalent to Chemotherapy-Induced Cardiotoxicity, representing the initial phase of the condition.

Sinus Tachycardia (possibly stress- or anxiety-related) is a general finding and not directly related to the specific disease entity of Chemotherapy-Induced Cardiotoxicity, although it could be a manifestation.
